title: FY2025 NDAA artificial-intelligence security, biosecurity, and assurance provisions
last_action: Enacted in the FY2025 National Defense Authorization Act.
summary: A curated group of FY2025 NDAA provisions directing assessment and protection of advanced AI from adversary access, piloting national-security AI and biotechnology applications, strengthening human-factors and testing infrastructure for military AI, and establishing the NSA Artificial Intelligence Security Center.
committee_dynamics: The provisions were enacted through the annual defense and intelligence authorization vehicle rather than as standalone AI statutes.
advance_rationale: Enacted law; implementation replaces advancement forecasting.

responsible_agencies: Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer Governing Council

deadlines.requirement: Establish the Artificial Intelligence Security Center within the NSA Cybersecurity Collaboration Center within 90 days of enactment.

agency_status.agency: Department of Defense and National Security Agency
agency_status.detail: The enacted duties and organizational requirements are verified; a comprehensive official implementation assessment has not yet been completed for this grouped record.

verification_level: Official public-law text and section grouping verified.

sources.title: Public Law 118-159 — FY2025 National Defense Authorization Act
